source.name: CoRE-MOF 2019 public ASR dataset
source.citation: CoRE-MOF 2019 dataset v1.1.4; accompanying paper DOI: 10.1021/acs.jced.9b00835.
source.conditions: CoRE public=Y, DISORDER field empty, from_CSD=Y; ASR means all solvents removed. CSD refcode WIZMAV02. Source CIF has 696 explicitly listed ordered sites, formula Zr3C42H26O16, full occupancy, and no guest species.

normalization.method: pymatgen 2026.5.4 CifParser.from_str(check_cif=False, frac_tolerance=0, site_tolerance=0); parse_structures(primitive=False, check_occu=True, on_error='raise'); SpacegroupAnalyzer(symprec=0.01 Å, angle_tolerance=5.0°)
details: CoRE metadata from_CSD=Y; CSD refcode WIZMAV02.
CoRE metadata Extension=auto; this label is preserved without interpretation.
The selected CoRE-MOF 2019 public ASR CIF payload is preserved byte-for-byte.
Retrieved the exact single record through the MOFX API (record id 185741, retrieval snapshot dc8a0295db); CIF SHA256 was checked against the independent source audit.

Raw CIF atom-site labels remain verbatim in source.cif. Parsed sites were uniquely matched to raw rows by element and periodic fractional-coordinate distance and reordered to that row order; sourceIndex is one-based and sourceAtomIds contains the corresponding normalized atoms.id values.
Space group and point group derived from normalized coordinates with pymatgen SpacegroupAnalyzer (spglib), symprec=0.01 Å, angle_tolerance=5.0°; recognition only, coordinates and cell unchanged.
CIF space-group label 'P1' differs from geometric recognition P2 at the recorded tolerance.
Source fractional coordinates converted to Cartesian Å; source cell vectors retained. Source atom-row ordering is restored only when a unique periodic-coordinate match is verified.

During this normalization, no atom was added or removed; upstream curated content is preserved as recorded in source.conditions. No custom symmetry operation, cell reduction, or supercell transform was applied.
All explicitly stated site occupancies were 1.0.
Mixed, unknown, or partial occupancy blocks the entry.
PBC [true,true,true] follows the CIF crystallographic cell format; no lower-dimensional PBC was inferred.
